relationships.rationale: Subdomains need live probing to be useful.
BBOT discovered hosts should be probed.
Resolved hosts are probed with httpx.
Probed surface is scanned by nuclei.
Endpoints found in JS feed secret scanning.
Masscan results need Nmap service detection.
Nuclei XSS candidates feed Dalfox validation.
Nuclei SQLi candidates feed sqlmap validation.
Research public exploits after template match.
Ghauri is an alternative to sqlmap.
XSStrike is an alternative to Dalfox.
Command injection validation uses OOB callbacks.
Semgrep is a lighter SAST alternative.
Payload library feeds XSS hypothesis generation.
Payload library feeds command injection hypotheses.

playbooks.name: Web initial recon
playbooks.objective: Identify live web assets, technologies, WAFs and initial entry points.

steps.objective: Enumerate subdomains and assets.
Probe live hosts and detect technology stacks.
Detect WAF and rate-limit behavior before active testing.

playbooks.description: Standard entry playbook for external web assessment.

playbooks.name: API endpoint discovery
playbooks.objective: Discover API routes, schemas and parameters for later assessment.

steps.objective: Crawl and extract endpoints from live traffic.
Extract endpoints and parameters from JavaScript.
Discover hidden API parameters.
Parse OpenAPI/Postman schemas when available.

playbooks.description: Discover API surface before focused assessment.

playbooks.name: Subdomain enumeration
playbooks.objective: Enumerate all in-scope subdomains through passive and active sources.

steps.objective: Passive subdomain enumeration from public sources.
Certificate transparency log lookups.
Resolve and deduplicate enumerated hostnames.

playbooks.description: Build the live subdomain set before probing.

playbooks.name: Network recon and service discovery
playbooks.objective: Discover reachable hosts, open ports and running services on in-scope networks.

steps.objective: Discover live hosts on the target range.
Scan for open ports.
Identify services and versions on open ports.

playbooks.description: Standard entry playbook for internal/network assessment.

playbooks.name: Web content and directory discovery
playbooks.objective: Discover directories, files and virtual hosts on target web applications.

steps.objective: Fuzz directories and files with tuned wordlists.
Discover virtual hosts.
Generate target-specific wordlists.

playbooks.description: Locate hidden content that expands attack surface.

playbooks.name: JavaScript analysis
playbooks.objective: Mine JavaScript assets for endpoints, secrets and hidden parameters.

steps.objective: Extract endpoints and URLs from JavaScript.
Discover secret indicators inside JavaScript.

playbooks.description: Leverage client-side code for attack surface expansion.

playbooks.name: Secret discovery
playbooks.objective: Locate credentials, tokens and keys exposed in scope.

steps.objective: Scan git repositories and files for secrets.
Discover secret indicators inside JavaScript.

playbooks.description: Find exposed secrets; never store raw credentials unredacted.

playbooks.name: Vulnerability triage
playbooks.objective: Prioritize candidate findings and decide what to validate and prove.

steps.objective: Scan for candidate vulnerabilities from discovered surface.
Correlate findings with topology and technology context.

playbooks.description: Candidates are not proof; this playbook feeds validation.

playbooks.name: XSS validation
playbooks.objective: Validate reflected, stored and DOM-based XSS candidates with execution evidence.

steps.objective: Confirm reflection and context of candidate parameters.
Confirm execution with a safe proof payload.

playbooks.description: A reflected parameter is NOT confirmed XSS without execution evidence.

playbooks.name: SQL injection validation
playbooks.objective: Validate SQL injection candidates with differential behavior and safe DBMS identification.

steps.objective: Confirm injection point and DBMS family.
Prove impact through safe verification only.

playbooks.description: Never automatically execute high-impact database actions.

playbooks.name: SSRF validation
playbooks.objective: Validate SSRF candidates via out-of-band interaction correlation.

steps.objective: Test candidate endpoints with OOB callback payloads.
Correlate interactions back to mission, target and request.

playbooks.description: Every interaction must be correlated with mission, target, request and token.

playbooks.name: SSTI validation
playbooks.objective: Identify template engine and validate SSTI with safe proof.

steps.objective: Detect template injection and identify the engine.
Confirm execution with a safe proof payload.

playbooks.name: XXE validation
playbooks.objective: Validate XXE candidates using direct and OOB XML interaction.

steps.objective: Detect XXE via safe external entity resolution.
Correlate OOB interactions and confirm impact.

playbooks.description: Pair XXE testing with an OOB callback server.

playbooks.name: GraphQL assessment
playbooks.objective: Assess GraphQL endpoints for introspection, query abuse and authorization issues.

steps.objective: Probe GraphQL schema and introspection status.
Analyze queries for abuse and misconfiguration.

playbooks.description: Introspection must be explicitly permitted by scope.

playbooks.name: Cloud assessment
playbooks.objective: Assess cloud posture, misconfigurations and exposed assets.

steps.objective: Audit cloud configuration against CIS-style frameworks.
Discover exposed cloud assets and storage.

playbooks.description: Feeds Sprint 017 Cloud Intelligence as evidence provider.

playbooks.name: Container and supply-chain assessment
playbooks.objective: Assess container images, dependencies and SBOMs for known vulnerabilities.

steps.objective: Generate SBOMs for in-scope images.
Scan images and dependencies for CVEs.

playbooks.description: Report-only supply-chain analysis; no destructive actions.

playbooks.name: Active Directory assessment
playbooks.objective: Assess AD/Windows infrastructure within an authorized internal scope.

steps.objective: Enumerate SMB, RPC and LDAP surfaces.
Extract AD attributes and trust information.

playbooks.description: Internal-network capability family, separate from web tooling.
